created_by: FlameLens data team, with an SI tool
si_use: An SI tool (Claude) wrote and ran the scripts that downloaded NASA's files, joined the as-run test matrix to the experimental table and copied each cell. The SI tool read each of NASA's 121 test observations and marked the phrase that states what happened; the marked phrases are in REPORT.md. A script checked every claim against the downloaded spreadsheet. No value was generated. The team's six members have checked the readings. For the video frames, the SI tool's scripts read the date and clock NASA's video system prints on each frame and searched NASA's videos for each test's start time; how, and the one-day clock offset, are in REPORT.md. For the Guide findings the SI tool chose the sentences, and a script cuts each one word for word from the PDF's text and stops if it is not found.
summary: Oxygen and pressure for all 121 BASS tests, air speed for 95, and what happened in 110, from NASA's as-run test matrix. 452 claims. Version 4: 9 findings in NASA's words from NASA's ISS Researcher's Guide: Combustion Science (2015), one of the challenge's listed resources.
